chapter: Kid Thomas band and dance work
title: Dances, picnics, truck rides and excursions with Red Allen
summary: With Allen they played halls, picnics, truck rides and excursions; one trip Twat got drunk and fell into the bass.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Well when you played with, uh, with Sonny Allen, did y'all play inside or outside mostly? With Sonny Allen. What, what you mean with Little Allen? Yeah, with Little Allen.

Well we used to play dances and things. Yeah. Used to go around and play dances and all like that when I was playing with him. Would that be in the halls or would it be in the... Be in the halls, yeah. Like back at the Turtle Park and Circuit Arts Hall and up in McDonaville, at the, at the McDonaville Hall to play up there. What about picnics over here? Well we used to go out on picnics too like that, go out and play picnics like that. Play truck rides, going to different towns like that. Like, sometimes they used to have truck rides leaving like you're going to Tibby Doe or... Yeah. Or... Home or somewhere like that, we'd play that, we'd play that truck ride going out there. Play excursions, excursions pull out of the yard. Sometimes they used to have on the teepee road there, they'd have excursions going out on the Sunday. We'd play them excursions going out. What? Me and Thomas played excursions going out there one time and Twat was with us. Twat got drunk and fell in the bass. Fell in the bass? Yeah. How did he do that? He broke it? He broke it? Got drunk over there trying to pick the bass and pick up on wobble and well, first thing you know him and the bass both went down.
